message.content: {"note_claim": "A cold crab ramen served at the Azabu-Juban Summer Festival was determined to be the cause of Salmonella food poisoning affecting 78 people, and Minato Ward ordered a 7-day business suspension under the Food Sanitation Act.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "令和8年9月3日から令和8年9月9日（7日間）の営業停止命令 備考 公表時の患者数：78名", "reason": "The official Minato Ward release confirms Salmonella food poisoning from cold crab ramen sold at the event, 78 patients, and a 7-day suspension order under the Food Sanitation Act, though the facility name is redacted so the link to 'Kappo Komewo' is not shown on this page."}

parsed.note_claim: A cold crab ramen served at the Azabu-Juban Summer Festival was determined to be the cause of Salmonella food poisoning affecting 78 people, and Minato Ward ordered a 7-day business suspension under the Food Sanitation Act.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: 令和8年9月3日から令和8年9月9日（7日間）の営業停止命令 備考 公表時の患者数：78名
parsed.reason: The official Minato Ward release confirms Salmonella food poisoning from cold crab ramen sold at the event, 78 patients, and a 7-day suspension order under the Food Sanitation Act, though the facility name is redacted so the link to 'Kappo Komewo' is not shown on this page.
